package.author: owayo
package.description: AI-powered smart commit message generator with multi-provider fallback

en-US.author: owayo
en-US.description: AI-powered smart commit message generator with multi-provider fallback
en-US.longDescription:
git-sc writes commit messages from your staged changes using AI coding agent CLIs,
falling back across providers automatically when one is unavailable or rate-limited.
It detects the commit format from recent history, supports amend, squash and reword,
and can exclude paths from the diff it sends.
en-US.name: git-sc
en-US.releaseNotes:
Install
Homebrew (macOS / Linux)
brew install owayo/git-sc/git-sc
winget (Windows)
winget install owayo.git-sc
Open a new terminal afterwards so that the updated PATH takes effect.
Download
Download git-sc-<target>.tar.gz for your platform from the assets below (.zip on Windows), extract it and put git-sc on your PATH. SHA256SUMS lists the checksums of all assets.
curl -fLO https://github.com/owayo/git-smart-commit/releases/download/v26.11.100/git-sc-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
tar -xzf git-sc-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
Full Changelog: v26.10.105...v26.11.100
